description.zh:
指定要查询的主机账户ID。
> 您可以调用[ListHostAccounts](~~204372~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the host account that you want to query.

> You can call the [ListHostAccounts](~~204372~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

description.zh:
指定要查询的主机账户所在堡垒机的实例ID。
>您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance where the host account that you want to query resides.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

description.zh:
指定要查询的主机账户所在堡垒机的区域ID。
>区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance where the host account that you want to query resides.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

title.zh: 获取指定主机账户详情

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost get-host-account --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-account-id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
